Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation readiness review — schedule priv-hosting architecture call

Elliot — thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next step: 

Summary from today:
- Primary driver: move inference workloads behind customer VPC for data residency and audit controls.
- Key constraints: VPC peering or PrivateLink preferred, strict egress controls, KMS integration for keys, expected steady throughput ~200 qps with spikes to 600.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + a short SOC questionnaire pending security review.

Proposed next step: schedule a 60–90 minute architecture review (Redwood infra + your Cloud Ops + Security) to walk topology, IP allowlists, and integration checklist. Please confirm the following so we can lock a slot: 
1) Which of the following windows work for your team (all PT):
   - Thu, Mar 10 — 10:00–11:30 AM PT
   - Thu, Mar 10 — 2:00–3:30 PM PT
   - Fri, Mar 11 — 9:00–10:30 AM PT

2) Who from Datacline should attend (roles suffice — we suggest CTO, Lead Security Eng, Cloud Ops lead).
3) Any pre-reads we should review? I can share a short architecture agenda and our priv-hosting checklist.

Attaching my call notes from discovery and a lightweight checklist for your reviews. If none of the slots work, tell me two that do and Ill coordinate.

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
